_meta.source: scripts in docs/DATASET.md 'Real labels' (P4, 2026-09-21): DBSCAN on the cached frames, verified by hand on renders

axis.note: median of the per-frame estimate_track axis over all 201 frames (train stationary); lateral is measured from it, + left

keys.gauge_margin: 1.4 m - (|lateral| - W/2): + inside the strict gauge, - outside
keys.h_above_rail: [min, max] height of the cluster above the rail head (per-frame track model)
keys.n_points: points of the cluster in the selection window (not an occlusion flag for real labels)

labels.person_crossing: person at 54.5-57 m crossing the track and standing beside it
labels.person_walkway: person walking away from the train on the left side, frames ~145-200
